annotations.title: Gross salary needed for a net amount in Turkey

description: The gross yearly salary in Turkey that leaves a given take-home pay, with the same situation options as net_salary. Use it to set a salary ask or check an offer.

fx_per_eur.description: Exchange rate: 1 euro = this many TRY, for the euro amounts. Default 38 (indicative).

incentive.description: Employer SGK incentive: 2 = 2 points (most sectors, 2026); 5 = 5 points (manufacturing); 0 = None. Default 2.

period.description: Whether net_target is per year or per month. Default year.

name: gross_for_target_net
